records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Engaged but low-signal: attended onboarding call [calendar:3ff09b31] and replied only "Will do, thanks" [email:eec1ad07]. 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone; active Pro plan and 8 days left leave room, but zero product progress after a live call suggests modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for getting back to me — glad the onboarding call was useful. Since we spoke, I wanted to make sure the first step is clear: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and get that first project set up with you — just name a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
